method: Fresh headed Chromium process and empty browser context for every repetition; OS/server filesystem caches are not flushed. Local HTTP server precompresses gzip responses before timing. Shell/model painted metrics end at two animation callbacks after visible DOM markers, not physical display presentation. ResourceTiming excludes service-worker background fetches; server network logs include them. Warm/offline scenarios follow one successful sample load and complete service-worker installation.
